intro: Ormer's Revenge begins the retributive campaign of Ormer Ironbraid, an explorer stranded high above the Whelgar Excavation Site in the Wetlands. After unearthing ancient fossilized bones, the dwarven dig team inadvertently drew packs of ravenous mottled raptors that slaughtered their companions and trapped the survivors on a rocky bluff.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The situation is severe, that much is for sure. When we uncovered these bones it attracted the Raptors. These filthy beasts killed my brethren and trapped me, Merrin and the poor Prospector up here.
Help clear the Wetlands of these Raptors, friend. Mottled Raptors and Mottled Screechers are just West of the bluff there. Kill 10 of each, if you can.
That will be a good start to the vengeance I have planned for them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Kill 10 Mottled Raptors and 10 Mottled Screechers, friend. My co-workers did not deserve the fate that was brought upon them. It's time to even the score.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Killing is a dirty business, but you did your job well, friend. If I weren't obligated to stay with the Prospector and Merrin, I'd be down there shedding blood right along side you.
